label: Cambodia
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels in Cambodia, in the capital Phnom Penh and the Angkor temple gateway of Siem Reap.
intro: Cambodia's coverage in this directory spans the two main visitor bases: Phnom Penh, the riverside capital and business centre, and Siem Reap, the laid-back town that serves as the gateway to the Angkor temple complex. The properties here are compact select-service and upscale city hotels rather than beach resorts.
